title: Alleged Increased Risk of Stroke for Older People who have Received Pfizer-Biontech COVID-19 Bivalent Vaccine
what_it_is: Alleged Increased Risk of Stroke for Older People who have Received Pfizer-Biontech COVID-19 Bivalent Vaccine

sections.label: Bivalent COVID-19 vaccine safety assessment
sections.summary: US and local data found no increased ischaemic stroke risk, and HSA reported lower severe adverse event rates for bivalent than original vaccines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Upon further investigations, the US Centers for Disease Control (CDC) and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) assessed that this was very unlikely to reflect a true risk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The signal of a possible risk was neither observed nor validated in other US safety systems or analyses, or by other countries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Similarly, our local data accrued for the bivalent vaccines so far also do not show any increased risk of ischaemic stroke after receiving either the bivalent Moderna/Spikevax or the Pfizer-BioNTech/Comirnaty vaccine.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In fact, HSA’s latest safety report showed that the incidence rate of severe adverse event after taking bivalent vaccines, at about one in 100,000, is lower than that of the original vaccines, at around seven in 100,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Similarly, the Expert Committee on COVID-19 Vaccination (EC19V) and Health Sciences Authority (HSA) maintain that the benefit of both the bivalent Moderna and Pfizer COVID-19 vaccines continue to outweigh the risks, especially for vulnerable individuals.

sections.label: VIFAP applicants stroke cases
sections.summary: No acute ischemic stroke cases occurred among vaccinated patients who later received VIFAP, and safety signals are monitored across the whole population.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Among the subset of patients having received the vaccine who then subsequently received the VIFAP that she referred to, the data has been released, there were no cases of acute ischemic stroke.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, the short answer to her question is zero.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But we do not monitor the VIFAP applicants or recipients only.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: We monitor and look for safety signals across the entire population of people who receive the vaccines, who come to our clinics or centres, who receive medical care at our hospitals.
